name: The Hours of My Love
source:
You have a stalker, rather a strange one at that. whose presence is invisible to everyone else except you.

Though that isn’t the only strange thing that has been happening.

With his strange cryptic words and a past, you wish to forget resurfacing.

The only thing you could do is survive the inevitable. 

[From [url=https://melodymoonlight305.itch.io/the-hours-of-my-love]itch.io[/url]]
